# FIRMUS

> Accounting, 1C reconciliation, and Uzbekistan 2026 tax calculators for multi-client accountants.

## Public Pages
- [Home](https://firmusv1.netlify.app/welcome): Platform overview and guest tools.
- [Tax Calculators](https://firmusv1.netlify.app/calculators): Free Uzbekistan 2026 VAT 12%, payroll, turnover tax, and vacation pay calculators.
- [Bank & 1C Reconcile](https://firmusv1.netlify.app/try): Browser-local Bank statement vs 1C reconciliation tool.
- [User Guide](https://firmusv1.netlify.app/guide): Complete guide to features, legal basis, 1C integration, and plans.
- [Privacy Policy](https://firmusv1.netlify.app/privacy): Data privacy and Zero-PII policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://firmusv1.netlify.app/terms): Public offer and usage terms.
